action_required:
1. Register at https://data.gov.in/user/register (free)
2. Obtain your API key from your account dashboard
3. Set environment variable: set DATAGOV_API_KEY=your_key_here
4. Re-run: python scripts/acquire_agmarknet_ogd.py
existing_mandi_data: See data/raw/market/raw_agmarknet_historical.json (8.5 MB, synthetic benchmarks) and data/processed/historical_market/historical_mandi_prices.json (10.1 MB, cleaned).
